notes.title: Fix It - The Handyman Simulator is now available on Steam! 🔌🛠️🪚
notes.notes:
Fix It - The Handyman Simulator is now available on Steam! 🔌🛠️🪚

[previewyoutube=e78I6mfVavo;full][/previewyoutube]

Take on tasks in all trades. Whether gardener, electrician or painter, experience all facets of the trades in Fix It. 👨‍🔧
In addition to the many different jobs, you can manage your own company, buy vehicles and land to lead your business to economic success. 
Electrics, installation, gardening or renovation? Where would you start?

Now available on Steam: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203320/Fix_It__Der_Handwerker_Simulator/
